correctness.rationale: For distance-two endpoints, the two possible intermediates have distance two from one another; conversely every distance-two selected pair is such a pair of intermediates. At distance three the cube has three possible internal vertices in each of its two layers. Each layer is pairwise at distance two, so a feasible set blocks at most one vertex per layer, and each such vertex hits only two of the six shortest paths. This proves the criterion directly. A distance-one pair extends within its fiber exactly when that factor has a third value; for a binary fiber any outside candidate has distances r and r+1, for r=1 or 2. A distance-three pair extends by a third symbol when one is available and otherwise is cube-antipodal and maximal. No singleton is maximal. This yields the stated pair census with no double-counting. In the doubly binary product, adjacent cells can coexist only at a shared symbol and create an isolated facet of size two; otherwise one diagonal contains the support, with one choice at most per symbol. Filling all symbols gives exactly its maximal faces since m is at least two. Counting these assignments and the adjacent pairs gives both polynomials, including their coincident facet degrees at m=2. Each diagonal complex is the boundary of a cross-polytope; contract one joining edge and use paths in the connected spheres to move endpoints of the other edge attachments to the wedge point. This gives 4m-1 additional loops and nine circles in the cube. The cited maximum yields the gap. An independent original-geodesics enumeration over all subsets for m=2,3,4 reproduced face and facet coefficients, including facet histograms {2:16}, {2:12,3:16} and {2:16,4:32}.
residual_risks: The bounded reproduction does not establish general m or topology; those conclusions use the proof above.

originality.rationale: The distinct same-day Resultary result covers the exact minimum-size and maximal-pair census by specialization of its general three-factor classification. Its date alone does not establish priority in either direction. The later publications document overlap of the remaining face enumerator and the full doubly binary classification, facets and homotopy type, not prior publication of those parts before the frozen record. The combined finding as stated is not supported as a distinct contribution; this is not a correctness failure or a claim of copying.
residual_risks: No within-day provenance was established. Later overlapping results do not resolve priority relative to this frozen record.
The source comparisons are not an exhaustive historical search.
